gloss: to give a ride, to put on

definitions.gloss: to give a ride, to let ride
definitions.explanation: To allow someone to board a vehicle.

definitions.gloss: to put on, to place on
definitions.explanation: To set something on a surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{乗|の}せて⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a ride to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せる。
examples.english: To put a child on a bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せて⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my friend a ride and dropped them off at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っていた→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せて⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: It was raining, so I gave my friend a ride home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}のひら→手のひら：05294_tenohira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せる。
examples.english: To place on the palm of the hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せた。
examples.english: I put the luggage on the shelf.

examples.japanese: お⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}せる。
examples.english: To place the food on a plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}せないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't put your things on the table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せられて、⟦つい→つい：02564_tsui⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I was talked into it by him and ended up buying something expensive.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- {乗|の}せる (transitive): to put (someone/something) on, to give a ride
- ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (intransitive): to ride, to get on

WRITING:
- {乗|の}せる: to give a ride, to put on (vehicles, surfaces)
- ⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧: to load, to publish, to post (cargo, articles)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せる: to give someone a ride
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せる/{乗|の}せられる: to be talked into, to be tricked
- ⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せる: to encourage (sometimes to excess)
- ⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}せる: to put on track, to get going
